acceptance: `benchbox setup --platform bigquery` offers an ADC route that saves the project and records that ADC is used, without a key file; a unit test with ADC detection stubbed saves credentials and the adapter constructs from them (no network).
The key-file route keeps working (existing tests pass).
The site BigQuery page documents both routes.
context: DECISION GATE: confirm the owner wants ADC support (it changes what setup accepts). No live cloud calls in tests.
description: benchbox/platforms/credentials/bigquery.py:27-71 requires a service-account JSON key file path and rejects anything else (`type` must be `service_account`). Users who authenticate with Application Default Credentials (`gcloud auth application-default login` plus `gcloud config set project`) cannot save BigQuery credentials through setup, although the BigQuery client library supports ADC. Found 2026-10-31 while writing site #96, which therefore documents only the key-file route.
